text: {Name} worked as a farmhand near {Place} until the landlord evicted the family from its rented fields. The farmhand kept writing poems and still hoped to publish a collection.
self_review: A farmhand loses the family tenancy when the landlord evicts them and continues writing poetry with hopes of publication.
source_pattern: The supplied oral history documents agricultural work before entering an armed movement and subsequent hardship.
fictional_changes: Tenancy, eviction, and the ambition to publish poems are fictional. The source does not document a poet or this reason for losing land.
